author: Jossiux
body:
Hello Avicans, 

As some of may have seen my post from a day ago asking for map making suggestions, I will try to make a space map. I'd like to see if you guys would be okay with it and want this kind of map made. Please give feedback. 

Your fellow Avican, 

Jossiux

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
If I were planning to create a space-theme map then these would be main factors to consider:
  • Constant night with night vision effect.
  • Strict grey based block palette
  • Jump boost pads
  • Use of glass for transparent/translucent platforms
Good luck with your map!

replies.author: NotPineapple203
replies.body:
So I have decided that I will not be doing a spae themed as well just for lack of features and physics in minecraft.
This means I can give you my ideas.
  1. Give constant jump boost for the 0 gravity feel. (maybe even slowness, probs not tho)
  2. See if you could build it in the End mainly for the galactic looking sky. you could also be cheeky with portals if you weren't able to.
  3. You are doing a space theme. You might as well go all out and put in the effort of making it a little more detailed (islands that look like debris or ufos)
